crossRefs.note: Let all the earth fear Yahweh. Let all the inhabitants of the world stand in awe of him.
You, even you, are to be feared. Who can stand in your sight when you are angry?
Make vows to Yahweh your God, and fulfill them! Let all of his neighbors bring presents to him who is to be feared.

translations.web: Worship Yahweh in holy array. Tremble before him, all the earth.
translations.bsb: Worship the LORD in the splendor of His holiness; tremble before Him, all the earth.
translations.kjv: O worship the LORD in the beauty of holiness: fear before him, all the earth.
translations.asv: Oh worship Jehovah in holy array: Tremble before him, all the earth.
